title: Comic Key-Issue Insurance Photo Gaps
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=comic:item
| stats count(eval(photo_present=false)) as missing_photos count(eval(key_issue=true)) as key_issues by storage_box
| sort 0 - missing_photos
description: Ranks storage boxess by insurance photo gaps.
value: Insurance coverage is most important on key issues, so missing photos deserve a direct queue.
implementation: Send insurance photo gaps events to `index=personal` and keep `storage_box` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of insurance photo gaps by storage boxes.
grandmaExplanation: It frames which storage boxess stand out most for insurance photo gaps.
